result.title: Imagine Smarter, Drive Faster: Efficient World Modeling for Decision-Aware Autonomous Driving
result.comment: 23 pages total, 8 pages main text (4 figures, 8 tables), 12 pages supplementary material (9 figures, 5 tables)
result.summary: World models hold great promise for autonomous driving planning, yet their ability to imagine the future often comes at a formidable computational cost. Efficiency efforts, such as knowledge distillation and domain-specific pre-training, often shift this burden to costly teachers or training pipelines, leaving lightweight world modeling an open challenge. We introduce FastWorld, a natively lightweight world-model framework for efficient autonomous driving planning. FastWorld reduces computation through compact scene representations, short-horizon action-conditioned prediction, and selective candidate verification and score refinement. These designs support efficient future-informed planning without teacher distillation or additional domain-specific pre-training. On NAVSIMv1, FastWorld achieves 92.2 PDMS at 132 FPS on a single 4090 GPU. It also achieves 89.4 EPDMS on NAVSIMv2 and an average L2 of 0.40 over 3 seconds at 17 FPS on nuScenes. Code and models can be found at https://github.com/MoyangSensei/FastWorld.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FastWorld，一个无需教师蒸馏或领域预训练的原生轻量世界模型框架，通过紧凑场景表示、短时程动作条件预测以及选择性候选验证与分数细化来降低未来推演成本，并在 NAVSIMv1 上报告 92.2 PDMS、单张 4090 上 132 FPS。
